description: Soft 1/7 so ds = soft*L = 1, da = L-ds = 6; the handle is on +X at distance d from the root, pole at rest (n = +Y). d = 7: de = 6 + (1 - e^-1) = 6.632121, stretch 0 so dc = de. x = (de^2+9-16)/(2 de) = 2.788326, h = sqrt(9-x^2) = 1.106906. The end stops short of the handle: hand (6.632121,0,0), the marker joint on the handle (7,0,0).
